idea-plugin.name: Dependency License Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Dependency License Lens

License compliance shouldn't be an afterthought. Dependency License Lens automatically detects and categorizes the license of every dependency in your project, flags risks, and enforces team policies — all without leaving your IDE.

Key Features

  • Automatic License Detection — Scans Gradle, Maven, and npm dependencies
  • Risk Categorization — Classifies licenses as permissive, weak copyleft, or strong copyleft
  • Compliance Dashboard — Project-wide view of all dependency licenses with risk indicators
  • Policy Enforcement — Define allowed/blocked licenses per project or organization
  • Inline Warnings — Editor annotations for dependencies with risky or unknown licenses
  • Transitive Dependencies — Traces license obligations through the entire dependency tree

Why Dependency License Lens?

A single GPL dependency can change the licensing obligations of your entire product. Catch license issues at development time — not during legal review before a release.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: License scanning, risk categorization, inline warnings for direct dependencies
  • Pro: Transitive dependency analysis, custom license policies, SBOM export (SPDX/CycloneDX), CI/CD policy gates, and team compliance dashboards
